description: The one search for everything on Foundaree: people and home services (plumber, electrician, tutor, home nurse, driver), delivery (grocery and food riders, couriers, 10-minute delivery store staff), farm products (home-grown vegetables from kitchen gardens, farmers, dairy, eggs, organic produce), professionals (developers, designers, founders), businesses and shops (grocery, vegetables, fish, bakery, salons, pet shops, tailor shops, tiffin, clinics, studios), and jobs or openings. Describe the need in plain words and give the place when you know it: "plumber free tomorrow" in "Kochi", area "Kakkanad". Set `kind` only when the user clearly wants one of people, businesses or jobs; the default searches all three. Returns `people`, `businesses` and `jobs` lists (each item has a `kind` and a `url`; businesses also a `price` and `bookable`) and a `next` hint. Use get for the full details of one result, and book to book or order. Foundaree is new: when a list is empty, say so rather than guessing.

kind.description: any (default), people, businesses, jobs or apps (partner mini apps).

need.description: What the user needs, in their words, e.g. "plumber for a leaking tap" or "React developer".

name: find
title: Find anything on Foundaree
